# MIDNAT

> Public documentation for MIDNAT, a synthetic equity perpetuals protocol on X Layer Testnet. This index describes public information only; the trading application is on a separate origin.

Canonical site: https://midnat.xyz/
Sitemap: https://midnat.xyz/sitemap.xml

## Protocol

- [Protocol overview](https://midnat.xyz/protocol): What MIDNAT is, in one page.
- [Markets](https://midnat.xyz/markets): Listed markets and their live parameter sets.
- [Fees](https://midnat.xyz/fees): The costs of a round trip.
- [Risk framework](https://midnat.xyz/risk): Protocol, trader and liquidity-provider risks.
- [Whitepaper](https://midnat.xyz/whitepaper): The canonical design document.
- [Contracts](https://midnat.xyz/contracts): Deployed addresses, roles and verification state.
- [Deployments](https://midnat.xyz/deployments): Deployment and owner-operation records.
- [Verify](https://midnat.xyz/verify): Independent verification steps and their limits.
- [Security](https://midnat.xyz/security): Security posture, key concentration and disclosure.
- [Status](https://midnat.xyz/status): Observable system status.
- [Changelog](https://midnat.xyz/changelog): Recorded protocol changes.
